City council approves monsoon drainage plan

CHENNAI, 4 June 2026 —

The city council on Tuesday approved a ₹1,200-crore plan to widen 140 km of storm-water drains before the north-east monsoon, after three years in which the same streets flooded.

"We will not wait for the next flood," the mayor said. Work on 38 stretches starts in July; the rest by September.

What changes for residents

  1. Road closures, announced a week ahead on the council website.
  2. Night work in residential areas only between 10 pm and 5 am.
  3. Complaints to ward offices, or by phone on 1913.
